scope: Narrow fixed monoalphabetic orthographic mapping proxy, not phoneme inference, syllabic or pictorial rebus search. Latin/MiddleEnglish/German existing corpus models retained with exact provenance. No claim of period matching or exhaustive language search.
selection: Use only v65 training folios f26/f31/f33, H hand2 botanical P. Rank unique words of >=4 EVA characters with training count<=2 by frozen v65 surprise; top20, lexical ties. Save full source lines and F alternatives. A selected unusual type need not itself be a name.
qualification: For each language take 3 fixed-seed sets from last20% of source corpus (language model trained first60%), training20 words exactly matching selected EVA lengths, plus20 separately sampled test words with same lengths. Encrypt with random fixed alphabet; infer key using unchanged v41 search. Freeze recovered keys before held-out scoring. Require >=90% held-out letter recovery in all3 cases perlanguage; otherwise no manuscript decoding for that language. Failure is solver/sample limitation, not evidence against encoding.
manuscript_stage: Only languages passing qualification may be searched. One fixed character-to-letter key, no deletions/reversals/context exceptions. Fit training selected words only. Freeze mappings before held-out scoring. H/F same key, no refit. Statistical word likelihood alone cannot establish semantic sense; no independent botanical-name anchors available. If no language qualifies, preserve failure and leave manuscript decoding closed.
heldout_limit: v65 already exposed statistical summaries and some anomaly words from test folios. Any later transfer is retrospective, not virgin confirmation.
